# James Gartshore

> Free, plain-English tech tips on phones, computers, scams and getting online, written for people in Bridlington, Driffield and across the East Riding of Yorkshire. Written by James Gartshore, who lives in Bridlington, England, and volunteers with a local tech support group. The tips are a separate, spare-time project.

- [Get help](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/help/): free UK help lines and services by problem (scams, hands-on tech help, access needs, money, wellbeing).
- [Tech words explained](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/glossary/): plain-English meanings of common tech words.
- [About James Gartshore](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/about/): who writes the tips, and where to find hands-on help.
- [Poster design examples](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/designs/): free posters designed for local people and groups.

## [Scams and staying safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/topics/scams-and-staying-safe/)

Free tips to spot, block and report scams by text, phone call, email and online, plus simple ways to keep your phone and computer safe.

- [Tracker Alerts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/tracker-alerts/): Today marks the start of the 16 Days of Activism against gender-based violence, so I wanted to share a phone safety feature that could really help someone.
- [Marketplace Scams](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-marketplace/): With Black Friday and Christmas shopping coming up, I wanted to share some tips for buying and selling safely on Facebook Marketplace and similar sites.
- [Fake Ads and Shops](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-ads-shops/): With Black Friday and Christmas shopping coming up, I wanted to share a warning about fake adverts and online shops.
- [Winter Fuel Payment Texts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-alert-winter-fuel/): Winter Fuel Payments start going out from mid-November, and scam texts about them are going round again.
- [Phone Antivirus](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-antivirus/): You do not need to install an antivirus app on an iPhone or Android phone, because protection is built in. Here is why.
- [Scam Texts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-texts/): Fake texts claim an unpaid parking fine, an HMRC refund or a fuel payment. Here is how to spot them and what to do. Free local help, Bridlington & Driffield.
- [Scam Emails](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-emails/): I wanted to share a warning about scam emails, as there are a lot going round at the moment pretending to be from well-known organisations.
- [WhatsApp Scams](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-whatsapp/): I wanted to share a warning about two WhatsApp scams that are really common at the moment.
- [Scam Calls](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-cold-calls/): I wanted to share some ways to cut down on scam and nuisance calls, as there's a new type going round that's worth knowing about.
- [Separate Accounts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/separate-accounts/): I wanted to share a simple tip that can make a big difference to keeping your computer safe: using separate accounts for different things.
- [Bank Call Scams](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-bank-calls/): I wanted to share a warning about one of the most costly scams going round at the moment: phone calls from people pretending to be your bank or the police.
- [Get Online Week Day 4](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/get-online-day4/): It's day four of Get Online Week, and today I wanted to talk about passwords, because they're something almost everyone struggles with.
- [Phone Still Safe](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-updates/): Phones only get free security updates for a certain time. Here is how to install waiting updates and check yours is still supported.
- [Get Online Week Day 3](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/get-online-day3/): It's day three of Get Online Week, and today's tips are about free tools that help you stay safe from scams.
- [Phone Stolen](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/phone-stolen/): I wanted to share what to do if your phone is ever lost or stolen, and a couple of things worth doing now, just in case.
- [Voice Clone Scam](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scam-voice-clone/): I wanted to share a warning about a scam that's becoming more common: phone calls using a copy of a family member's voice.
- [Fake Parcel Texts](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/fake-parcel-texts/): A text says a parcel could not be delivered and asks for a fee? Here is how to check safely using the courier's own app.
- [Find a Bad App](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/find-bad-app/): Seeing adverts on your home screen or over other apps? A bad app may be installed. Here is how to track it down using your battery settings.
- [Scary Pop-up Ads](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/scary-popup-ads/): I wanted to share a tip about those scary pop-ups that sometimes appear on phones.
- [Computer Safety](https://jamesgartshore.co.uk/pc-safety/): I wanted to share a few tips about keeping your computer safe, because a lot of people end up paying for antivirus they don't actually need.
